summary: A local shop that makes goods to order and delivers them the same or next day in its area: a seasonal catalogue, delivery areas with fees and cut-off times, and an order form whose delivery date follows the area and the clock. Fits florists, gift shops, cake and made-to-order bakery shops and similar.

pages.purpose: Tell the visitor at once whether an order today still arrives today, show this season's pieces, and answer delivery area and price before they ask.

sections.purpose: Masthead with the season or week's edition, a featured piece with its price, and a live same-day status (time left before the cut-off, or when the next delivery is).
alternatives: countdown: the cut-off is the main message — count down to today's order deadline
fields: Featured piece: photo, name, starting price
Same-day order cut-off time and time zone
sections.notes: The status depends on the clock: render it after mount. State the remaining time as text ('order within N h for delivery this evening'), not only as a ticking clock, and update it in a polite live region.

sections.purpose: This week's or season's selection as a feature spread: photo, name, what is in it, price from, 'order this' button that opens the order page with the item chosen.
alternatives: carousel: many pieces in the edit
fields: Seasonal pieces: photo, name, contents/ingredients, sizes with prices

sections.purpose: Three short promises or refusals that set the shop apart (sourcing, freshness, packaging).
fields: Three concrete promises about sourcing, freshness or packaging

sections.purpose: Recurring orders (weekly or monthly deliveries) for homes or offices, with plans and prices.
fields: Subscription plans: frequency, size, price per delivery

sections.purpose: Delivery areas with fee, earliest delivery (same day / next day) and time windows.
alternatives: pin-map: areas are easier to grasp on a map (keep the table as the text equivalent)
sections.notes: A wide table goes in a focusable, labelled scroll region on phones.

sections.purpose: The physical shop for walk-ins and pick-up: map, address, opening hours.
Freshness, care, substitutions when an item is out of season, cut-offs, anonymous gifts, refunds.
fields: Questions and answers on substitutions, care, delivery failures and refunds

pages.purpose: The whole current catalogue with a simple filter and a size switch that updates every price.

sections.purpose: Title and a line on what is in season.
fields: One sentence on the current season

sections.purpose: Filter (this week's edit / long-lasting / budget or occasion) and a size switch (small / medium / large) over a grid; each card has 'order this'.
alternatives: empty-state: shown when a filter matches nothing
fields: All pieces: photo, name, occasion/category, price per size
sections.notes: Prices follow the chosen size; announce the result count in an aria-live region. The chosen piece and size are kept across pages and language switches.

pages.purpose: Place an order for a delivery date: piece and size, area, date and time window, gift card message, recipient and sender.

sections.purpose: A sectioned order form: 1 piece and size, 2 area + date + time window, 3 card style and message, 4 recipient and sender; a sticky summary with the card previewed as written.
alternatives: form-02: a single long form without steps
checkout-01: when payment is taken on the same page
fields: Cut-off time, closed days, how many days ahead orders are taken
Card styles with any extra price and the message character limit
Payment method or 'pay on confirmation' rule
sections.notes: The calendar's earliest day and the time windows follow the chosen area and the cut-off; keep the chosen day and window valid when either changes. Allow an anonymous sender. The live card preview is decorative; the summary carries the same facts as text in a polite live region. End with an order reference.

pages.purpose: For special and large orders (events, corporate gifting) that do not fit the order form.

sections.purpose: Contact form for custom orders with date, budget and occasion, plus phone and messaging.
alternatives: page-contact-01: a full contact page with map and branches
fields: Lead time for custom and event orders

content: Current catalogue: piece name, photo, contents, sizes and price per size
How often the selection changes (weekly, seasonal)
Same-day order cut-off time, time zone and closed days
Delivery areas with fee, same-day availability and time windows
Card message options (styles, extra price, character limit)
Substitution policy when an item is unavailable
Payment methods and when payment is taken
Shop address, opening hours and phone
Good photos of real products with alt text

styles.name: soft magazine
styles.why: Magazine serif headlines with italic emphasis, a warm coral-pink accent and soft blurred motion suit florists and gift shops selling an emotional purchase.

styles.name: warm bakery counter
styles.why: Warm accent and calm solid surfaces for made-to-order food gifts and cake shops.

styles.name: fresh local
styles.why: Plain, bright and fast for a shop whose customers mostly order on the phone.

pitfalls: Cut-off shown only as a ticking clock; screen readers and quick readers need it as text, and it must use the shop's time zone, not the visitor's.
Calendar allowing dates the shop cannot deliver (closed days, past cut-off, too far ahead, areas without same-day delivery).
Delivery fees hidden until checkout; show the area table on the home page.
No substitution policy for seasonal items that run out, leading to disputes.
Recipient phone and address collected without saying why or how long they are kept (privacy notice required).
Card message preview with no character limit or one that differs from the printed card.
Motion (swinging tags, blurred fades) not stopped for reduced motion.
